header.title: What might come next?
header.intro: Follow the clues, watch the tokens race, then let the teaching model make its guess.

candidates.title: Watch the token race
candidates.barHelp: Each bar shows how strongly this teaching model favours a token here.

story.continue: The new token becomes part of the next clue.
story.compareHelp: Compare a predictable run with a more varied run.
story.compareEmpty: Run the comparison to reveal two possible choices.

temperature.title: Predictable ↔ Varied
temperature.help: Move the dial to spread the chances out or pull them together. It does not make the model smarter or creative like a person.

truth.label: Simplified teaching model — not Qwen probabilities.
truth.patterns: The model predicts patterns; it does not check which answer is true.
truth.chance: A high chance does not guarantee a token will be chosen.
truth.fluent: A sentence can sound fluent and still be wrong.

welcome.title: Welcome to Prediction
welcome.body: Follow a clue and see possible next tokens race.

clue.title: Start with the clue
clue.body: The text so far changes which token looks likely next.

race.title: Watch the candidates
race.body: Longer bars mean stronger chances in this teaching model.

temperature.title: Change the race
temperature.body: Move Temperature to make choices more predictable or more varied.

choose.title: Make a guess
choose.body: Pick a candidate or let the teaching model choose.

compare.title: Try it twice
compare.body: Replay to compare predictable and varied choices.
